notes.title: 0.2.1 - Bug fixing
notes.content:
BUG FIXES
Since 0.2.0 release a few bugs have been found. Expect similar small update like this one to come regularly.

Fixed:

 Bots not synchronizing properly when multiple clients connected
 Platforms in base being too high making it unnecessarily difficult for Bob to reach

That's it!

Ok! Games Team

notes.title: 0.2.0 OUT NOW
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821057/ba12edff54c7d0b8ab1f153b93ea1c1304d87636.png

AFTER 3 YEARS OF SILENCE WE ARE BACK AND WE ARE BETTER THAN EVER!

HIGHGROUNDS

With this new update we introduce Highgrounds! Highgrounds is a completely new map that has one key difference from all other maps... portals! There are two sets of portals in the map, each one has its own blue and red portal. Through the blue one you can enter and exit at the red one. Keep in mind, only PLAYERS can go through portals! Things like grenades and bullets will not!

SHIELDS
We noticed most of you suck at the game so, together with Highgrounds, we introduce shields! A new powerup which gives you an extra 60 health points in order to be alive more time and hopefully suck less! Keep in mind other players can see how much shield you have and no, you are not cool for not dying once and at the same time having 0 kills, you know who you are.

BUG FIXING
Not only have we added all these new things but a few bugs have been fixed:

 Banana gun now shoots actual bananas
 Fixed weird bug where Discord would open
 Fixed some weapons being able to shoot through floors
 Weapons not picked up should now display the appropriate sprite

GRASSLAND AND BASE REWORK
Last but not least, Grassland and Base have received a complete rework! They are now bigger and better than ever! With more jump pads, weapons and overall items we can't wait to see what you guys do!

Lastly, we would like to sincerely apologize for abandoning you guys for so long, we'll try not to do it again, no promises though! To another year of Gun Duel!

Ok! Games Team

PD: Your in-game name's will reset.
